subject: CloudForge + Redwood: joint AWS Marketplace walkthrough — co-host coordination
messages:
From: Sara Wong <sara.wong@cloudforge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Nadia Singh <nadia.singh@cloudforge.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood + CloudForge: AWS Marketplace joint walkthrough (initial ask)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking this conversation — CloudForge is excited to get a joint Marketplace walkthrough scheduled with Redwood so we can align the listing flow, co-sell collateral, and the live demo cadence we plan to present to AWS marketplace ops.

Quick context: AWS requested a short 45-minute joint session that covers:
- 10m: Marketplace listing & procurement flow (AWS ops)
- 25m: 2x demo segments (marketplace provisioning + integration patterns)
- 10m: next steps & support commitments

Can your team co-host the live provisioning/demo portion? Our preferred windows (PST) this week are:
- Tue 6/29 13:00–14:00
- Wed 6/30 10:00–11:00

I've attached our initial runbook (CF-Redwood-runbook-v1.pdf) and a simple availability grid. If those slots don't work, happy to trade availability. AWS ops (copied separately) asked that we lock something by end of day tomorrow.

Attachments: CF-Redwood-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook draft)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15m quick sync if helpful.

—Sara
Sara Wong
Partnerships, CloudForge
https://cloudforge.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Wong <sara.wong@cloudforge.com>, Nadia Singh <nadia.singh@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + CloudForge: AWS Marketplace joint walkthrough (initial ask)

Hi Sara / Nadia —

Appreciate the runbook and the clear time windows. We can definitely co-host the provisioning + integration demo; Vanessa and Vivek are looped for scheduling and technical scope.

Quick notes from our side:
- We can take the hands-on provisioning demo and a 10–12 minute deep-dive on our Dedicated routing for marketplace auth.
- Jonas (platform lead) will join as primary tech for failover questions — copying him separately.

Availability from Redwood (PST):
- Tue 6/29 13:30–14:15 (we can compress the agenda to fit 45m)
- Wed 6/30 10:00–11:00 (preferred — leaves room for rehearsal)

If Wednesday 10:00–10:45 works for AWS and your team, let's lock that. Otherwise we can split: Redwood takes provisioning on Tue and CloudForge leads the integration demo Wed (if you prefer multi-slot).

Next steps if Wed 10:00 works:
1) I'll send a calendar invite with the runbook attached and an internal rehearsal 30m before the call.
2) Vanessa will share the final slide deck and Vivek will provide a short checklist of network/KMS pre-reqs.
3) Please confirm whether AWS ops needs us to include additional attendees (procurement contact / marketplace engineer).

Attachments referenced: availability-grid.ics (I'll add our calendar invite when confirmed)

—Evelyn Hart
Director, Partnerships (Redwood Inference)
From: Nadia Singh <nadia.singh@cloudforge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sara Wong <sara.wong@cloudforge.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 12:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood + CloudForge: AWS Marketplace joint walkthrough (initial ask)

Thanks Evelyn —

Wed 6/30 10:00–10:45 PST works for CloudForge and matches AWS ops availability. A couple of operational asks before we lock:
- Can Redwood's portion include a short mention of the Dedicated vs. Hosted procurement flow (2–3 slides)? AWS specifically asked for clarity on data isolation and routing.
- We have one SI attendee in APAC (Sami) who will watch a recording; we don't need a split live window but we do want to confirm the recording / Q&A follow-up plan.

I've attached a small availability matrix and our preferred speaker roster. If you can confirm presenters for the 25m demo block (who leads which segment), we'll update the runbook and send to AWS ops.

Attachments: availability-matrix.pdf

Best,
Nadia
Nadia Singh
Head of Alliances, CloudForge
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 14:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Redwood + CloudForge: AWS Marketplace joint walkthrough (initial ask)

Evelyn / team —

Quick confirmation: I can take the technical deep-dive on the provisioning path and handle live troubleshooting during the demo. If anything comes up with my schedule I will ask Vivek to backfill (he's on cc).

I propose this split for the 25m demo block (Wed 10:00–10:25 PST):
- 0–5m: handoff & short context (Evelyn)
- 5–15m: provisioning live demo (Jonas)
- 15–25m: integration patterns + failover (Vivek)

I'll prep a 2-slide checklist on KMS and auth flows to keep the Q&A crisp.

—Jonas
Principal Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Wong <sara.wong@cloudforge.com>, Nadia Singh <nadia.singh@cloudforge.com>, AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + CloudForge: AWS Marketplace joint walkthrough (final)

Thanks all — Wed 2028-06-30 10:00–10:45 PST is locked for the joint walkthrough. Agreed agenda and owners below:

Agenda (45m)
- 0–5m: Welcome + objectives (Evelyn)
- 5–15m: Marketplace listing & procurement summary (Sara / AWS ops)
- 15–30m: Live provisioning demo & auth KMS notes (Jonas)
- 30–40m: Integration patterns, failover, routing controls (Vivek)
- 40–45m: Next steps & action items (Vanessa)

Action items before the call:
1) Vanessa: finalize slide deck and send to Nadia by EOD today.
2) Jonas: share the 2-slide KMS checklist and confirm demo account IDs.
3) Vivek: add the network/KMS pre-reqs to the runbook (I've attached CF-Redwood-runbook-v1.pdf for reference).
4) Sara / Nadia: confirm AWS ops attendee list (procurement contact + marketplace engineer).

I've created the calendar invite and attached availability-grid.ics; please accept when you see it. We'll also schedule a 30m internal dress rehearsal at 9:30 PST on Wed.

If any last-minute conflicts appear, propose them in-thread and we'll flip to the Tue compressed slot (13:30–14:15 PST) as backup.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth run.

—Evelyn Hart
Director, Partnerships (Redwood Inference)
Attachments: CF-Redwood-runbook-v1.pdf, availability-grid.ics
